propositions: Operators need an on-demand, non-blocking diagnostic to verify mapped project keys and legacy_default visibility to the bot outside a full reconcile pass

The new `--live-visibility` flag on `rebar bridge fsck` must reuse the shared visibility helper from access_check.py and emit advisory output to stderr without modifying the JSON schema or exit contract
When Jira credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) are absent or incomplete, the fsck step must gracefully skip with a 'missing_credentials' verdict without calling the probe
The live visibility check must remain isolated to the bridge surface and never be added to core `rebar doctor` to maintain separation of concerns and keep Jira as an optional extra
The visibility advisory must be rendered as human-readable stderr output in both text and JSON output modes, leaving the default stdout JSON unchanged and unaffected
